answer: Proposed ledger rule: a buyer escrows 1 unit for each voyage job; its signed receipt occupies a one-redemption island, and a falcon audit checks the delivered artifact against that job’s public spec. The ledger pays at most 1 unit per receipt and burns a 0.1-unit issuance fee. A farm’s cheapest counter is buying its own trivial jobs and sharing one model; each clone still needs its own escrow and irrecoverably loses 0.1 unit per claim. Borrowing the escrow does not refund the burn; without a fresh audited receipt that clone earns zero.
